intro: Trying to find Maine scholarships in the USA that consider financial need and stay on the lower-award end can narrow the search fast. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings where award amounts are below the higher-dollar ranges many broad scholarship pages mix in. The programs below do not follow one pattern: deadlines differ by listing, award amounts vary within this range, and requirements can be lighter for some rows while others may ask for more documentation or an essay. You can apply more efficiently by comparing each row closely instead of assuming the same rules across the list. If you are planning your scholarship search for the upcoming cycle, it is worth checking these Maine options promptly because some listings may close sooner than others.

faq.question: Can I apply to more than one scholarship listed here?
faq.answer: Usually, this catalog view is for finding and comparing separate programs, not one combined application. Check each row’s official source to see whether you can apply, what materials are required, and whether the program is open to your study level in the USA.

If you want to explore fit quickly, open the rows that match your level and field, then verify the full eligibility rules on the official pages.
